camera.status.reconnecting: The picture from {label} was lost. Retrying (attempt {n}) …
camera.error.closed: The camera was closed before it had started.
camera.error.busy: {label} is still in use by the previous preview. Wait a moment and choose the camera again.
camera.error.lost: The picture from {label} did not come back. Check the cable and select the camera again.
camera.error.system_open: Could not start {label}. Close other programs that use the camera (Teams, Zoom, the Camera app) and try again.
camera.error.rtsp_open: Could not connect to {url}. Check the address, user name and password, and that the camera is on the same network.
camera.error.file_unreadable: Cannot read the video file {name}. It may be damaged or in a format the program cannot open.
camera.error.recorder_open: Could not start recording to {path}. Check that the folder exists and that the disk has free space.
camera.error.recorder_write: Recording to {path} stopped. The disk may be full.
camera.gopro.hint.not_found: No GoPro found. Switch the camera on, connect the USB cable and set this on the camera: Preferences → Connections → USB Connection → GoPro Connect. If it says MTP, the camera only shows up as a memory card.
camera.gopro.err.unreachable: The GoPro ({host}) does not answer. Check that it is on and connected with the USB cable, and that USB Connection is set to GoPro Connect (Preferences → Connections → USB Connection → GoPro Connect).
camera.gopro.err.no_webcam_mode: The GoPro was found but has no webcam mode. Set Preferences → Connections → USB Connection → GoPro Connect on the camera, and update the camera software with GoPro Quik if that does not help.
camera.gopro.err.busy: The GoPro is busy. Go back to the home screen on the camera, wait a few seconds and try again.
camera.gopro.err.recording: The GoPro is recording. Stop the recording on the camera and try again.
camera.gopro.err.unavailable: Webcam mode cannot start. Check that USB Connection is set to GoPro Connect on the camera: Preferences → Connections → USB Connection → GoPro Connect. Then restart the camera.
camera.gopro.err.invalid_param: The GoPro cannot stream the chosen resolution as a webcam. Choose 1080p or 720p.
camera.gopro.err.timeout: The GoPro did not answer in time. Unplug and reconnect the USB cable and try again.
camera.gopro.err.set_preset: The GoPro could not switch to webcam mode. Close the menus on the camera, go back to the home screen and try again.
camera.gopro.err.webcam_failed: The GoPro could not start the webcam (error {code}). Restart the camera and try again.
camera.gopro.err.no_stream: The GoPro started the webcam but no picture arrives. Allow Tröskel (Lopanalys.exe) in the Windows firewall (UDP port {port}) and try again.
camera.gopro.err.record_start: Could not start recording on the GoPro. Check that there is a memory card with free space in the camera.
camera.gopro.err.record_stop: Could not stop recording on the GoPro. Press the camera's record button to stop it.
camera.gopro.err.media_list: Could not read the GoPro's memory card.
camera.gopro.err.no_new_file: The recording was not found on the memory card. Check that the camera recorded (the light blinks red) and that the card is not full.
camera.gopro.err.download: Could not download {name} from the GoPro. Check the USB cable and try again.
camera.gopro.err.download_short: The download of {name} was incomplete. Try again.
camera.gopro.warn.setting: The GoPro did not accept the setting {what}. Set it on the camera instead.
camera.gopro.stage.saving: The camera is saving the file …
camera.cli.preview_help: Press q or Esc to quit. Frames/s: {fps}
camera.gopro.hint.windows_driver: A GoPro is connected, but Windows has set it up as a serial port ({port}) instead of a network adapter, so it cannot be used. Install the GoPro Webcam program from GoPro (it contains the driver), unplug and replug the USB cable, then quit GoPro Webcam from its icon by the clock. Then press Search again.
camera.error.stream_auth: {url} needs a user name and a password. Write the address as user:password@address, for example admin:admin@192.0.2.50:8081/video.
camera.error.not_mjpeg: {url} answers, but not with a video stream (the reply is {type}). Check the address in the app on the phone.
camera.cli.stream_none: No stream answered at {address}. Check that the app is running on the phone and that the phone and the computer are on the same Wi-Fi.
